<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Game restarted (SPACE after GAME_OVER resets). Timer N=62 counting down. Paddle back at start (16-19,12-31).
# Ball (c+M) at top (1-7,36-39) - never moved in prev run. Need to find how ball moves.
# Hypothesis: ball falls when paddle is under it. Move paddle under ball (cols 28-47), then observe.
# Paddle at cols 12-31, each RIGHT = +4 cols. Need +16 = 4 RIGHTs to reach cols 28-47.
r = action(['RIGHT']*4)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('b','c','M','N'):
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        print(n['color'], min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
print('state', r['state'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
